quote_free_diagnosis: Differentiability of relative volume at a continuous psh metric is proved over arbitrary complete non-Archimedean fields, using actual nef/ample model approximations and field extension. This statement is not outer-envelope differentiability at every continuous metric.

Section3.2 assumes continuity of envelopes explicitly. The volume-energy identification and differentiability at continuous psh metrics then imply orthogonality; conversely orthogonality supplies the outer-envelope derivative through uniform envelope stability and MA convergence. No unconditional continuity result for every nondiscrete higher-dimensional field is supplied here.

Section3.3 additionally assumes a nonpluripolar L-regular point, meaning its singleton equilibrium is actually continuous psh. Its short variational proof gives the raw V point mass only after those antecedents. It does not prove all-point regularity or every finite-energy target equation on all original fields.

The analytic/model/cohomological inputs of Lemma3.2, Theorem2.4, volume-energy identification, and equilibrium regularity cite further primary dependencies. Reading the complete application units does not certify those entire recursive proof chains.

Thus this paper cannot currently be used to close the normalized actual-PSH compactness, envelope continuity, arbitrary-target attainment or every-solution allpoint uniqueness gaps of originalP16.4. The field-general continuous model volume theorem remains relevant only under its exact hypotheses.
